record_schema_notes.native_record_audit_alias_rule: The first listed key present is the canonical value; older batch keys retained without rewriting source receipts.
record_schema_notes.settings_rule: spectre.settings_requested retains each original preparation schema. All eight settings_effective objects share global_reltol/transient_reltol/vabstol_V/iabstol_A/maxstep_s/log_sha256; reason and preset are descriptive metadata, not alternate numerical setting fields. Requested integration_method and method describe the original deck vocabulary; actual deck hash is authoritative.
record_schema_notes.construction_rule: construction is frozen independent expected behavior. all_native_records_constant=true is the constant mathematical expectation, not an observed bitwise-constant assertion.
record_schema_notes.event_history_rule: compatible is derived from intersection_T[0] <= intersection_T[1]; zero width is explicitly single_point_contact, with no timing certificate inferred.
